authority_boundary.issue_125: A GO may authorize beginning guarded scheduling-control implementation in ramideltoro/nutsnews-worker#150 only.
authority_boundary.issue_150: Implements a reversible legacy ingestion-dispatch flag while preserving the DNS failover controller and deploys with dispatch enabled.
authority_boundary.issue_126: Implements protected dry-run, apply, verify, and rollback controls but leaves legacy dispatch enabled and uplift production writes disabled.
authority_boundary.issue_166: Freezes the exact candidate, watermark, absolute deadline, observation timestamps, thresholds, owners, and successful rollback rehearsal, then may issue a separate GO for #127.
authority_boundary.issue_127: Is the only issue allowed to execute an explicitly approved ingestion-owner switch.
authority_boundary.issue_128: May decommission legacy ingestion only after the full observation window succeeds.

cutover_watermark.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators
cutover_watermark.watermark_id_rule: sha256 of the canonical value-source snapshot plus exact candidate manifest

value_sources.source: protected #150 ingestion-scheduler status and apply receipt
value_sources.required_boundary: legacy dispatch disabled and in_flight_legacy_dispatch_count=0 while DNS failover remains active

value_sources.source: protected backend worker-runtime status plus queue inspection
value_sources.required_boundary: all main and retry queues drained, every DLQ explained at zero growth, and each main queue has exactly one consumer
every declared stage watermark has lag_count=0 and no stage is behind its confirmed publish boundary
unconfirmed_count=0, retrying_count=0, and dead_lettered_count=0 for every stage

value_sources.source: worker_uplift_final aggregate and API-command receipt counts plus final-domain natural-key inventory
value_sources.required_boundary: failed_api_command_receipt_count=0 and the natural-key digest is frozen before production output is enabled
every identity is immutable and matches deployed value-free evidence

invalidation_triggers: any candidate image, package, contract, topology, identity, or write-policy hash changes
legacy dispatch resumes after the fence snapshot
any queue, retry, DLQ, outbox, or reconciliation count changes before the owner switch
any source timestamp is stale, missing, unordered, or outside the approved window
any watermark lag, unconfirmed outbox row, failed API receipt, or unexplained domain effect exists
DNS failover state or controller resources differ from the #166 preflight

eligibility_requirements: current time is not later than the frozen absolute deadline
the #166-approved watermark and exact candidate still match
uplift scheduler can be fenced before changing owner state
every uplift-only committed domain effect after the watermark is present in the durable audit and visible to the legacy natural-key dedupe boundary
no unexplained lost or duplicate boundary effect exists
the protected rollback preflight returns eligible
DNS failover remains independent and unchanged
early_invalidation_triggers: an uplift-only domain effect cannot be proven safe for legacy dedupe
the watermark or audit evidence is incomplete or stale
the rollback rehearsal no longer matches deployed controls
action_order: wait for uplift consumers to settle or safely preserve unacknowledged work
atomically disable uplift production writes and set the recorded owner to legacy_shards
verify zero uplift production output after the owner transaction
restore legacy ingestion dispatch through the #150 reversible flag
prove exactly one production owner, compare the frozen watermark, and preserve all uplift queues, outboxes, and audit rows
rerun API, feed, admin, queue, DLQ, Grafana, and DNS-failover verification
rollback.after_invalidation_policy: forward recovery only unless a separately reviewed sync-back proof establishes zero loss and zero duplication
rollback.legacy_assets_retained_until: issue #128 closes after the full observation window

observation_window.ends_at: starts_at plus 48 hours, frozen as an absolute UTC timestamp by #166

thresholds.success: exactly one owner and it is worker_uplift after the switch
thresholds.abort: any overlap, unknown owner, or owner/write-policy mismatch
any service unhealthy for two consecutive checkpoints

thresholds.measure: consumer count on each of seven required main queues
thresholds.abort: any required queue has zero consumers for two consecutive checkpoints

thresholds.measure: messages_ready and messages_unacknowledged per main queue
thresholds.abort: either limit is exceeded for two consecutive checkpoints or grows across both checkpoints
age > 900 seconds for two checkpoints or > 1800 seconds once

thresholds.measure: new messages across seven route DLQs
watermark lag, unconfirmed outbox, retrying outbox, and dead-lettered outbox
thresholds.abort: any count remains nonzero for two checkpoints or boundary evidence diverges once

thresholds.measure: lost or duplicate production effects across the frozen watermark
thresholds.abort: any lost, duplicate, or unverifiable boundary effect

thresholds.measure: failed or rejected production Worker DB API command receipts
thresholds.abort: any failed or rejected production receipt

thresholds.measure: backend request availability and error-free requests
thresholds.success: >= 99.5 percent over the rolling observation window
thresholds.abort: either SLI < 99.5 percent for two consecutive checkpoints

thresholds.success: >= 95 percent over the rolling observation window
thresholds.abort: SLI < 95 percent for two consecutive checkpoints

thresholds.measure: feed refresh samples with age <= 900 seconds
thresholds.success: >= 99 percent over the rolling observation window
thresholds.abort: SLI < 99 percent for two consecutive checkpoints or no fresh sample for 900 seconds

thresholds.measure: RabbitMQ publisher confirm timeout or nack rate
root disk, memory, normalized load, and failed systemd units
thresholds.success: disk <= 80 percent, memory <= 80 percent, load/vCPU <= 1.5, failed units = 0
thresholds.abort: any limit is exceeded for two checkpoints or a failed required unit appears

thresholds.measure: approval/translation consecutive failures, unresolved retries, OpenAI calls, and OpenAI spend
thresholds.success: failures = 0, unresolved retries = 0, OpenAI calls = 0, OpenAI spend USD = 0
thresholds.abort: any unresolved AI-stage failure, retry amplification, OpenAI call, or OpenAI spend

thresholds.measure: Grafana data freshness and critical worker-uplift alerts
thresholds.success: Prometheus and Loki current; critical alerts = 0
thresholds.abort: telemetry stale for two checkpoints or any unexplained critical alert

thresholds.measure: controller health, alarm/cron, Durable Object state, DNS readback, status/actions, and analytics disposition
thresholds.success: all #166-frozen checks pass and controller state is unchanged
thresholds.abort: any controller surface is unhealthy, missing, modified, or unverifiable

ownership.owner_unavailable_policy: No recurring owner response is required for an exact machine-validated operation under the #166 standing authorization; any scope or evidence drift fails closed, retaining legacy_shards as owner and uplift production writes false.
ownership.backup_model: Each domain names a fail-closed safe-state control rather than fabricating an unavailable second person.

legacy in-flight count zero; uplift scheduler paused; queues/outboxes/reconciliation settled; DNS failover unchanged
canonical watermark artifact and digest match the #166 frozen candidate
#126 compare-and-swap transaction proves prior owner legacy_shards and cannot create two writers
uplift scheduler active; boundary smoke/parity passes; every threshold green; DNS failover unchanged

evidence_custody.artifact_owner: GitHub Actions protected backend and infra workflows

required_exact_fields: cutover_watermark complete value-source snapshot and SHA-256
threshold evaluation artifact IDs and digests
eight image digests and source commits
runtime configuration, topology, identity, and write-policy hashes
DNS failover controller and analytics disposition evidence
